environment.description: Same Go 1.20 microservice deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 in a Podman container with a custom AppArmor profile 'microservice-redirect-svc' loaded via apparmor_parser. The profile specifies: deny capability dac_override, deny /etc/shadow r, deny /etc/passwd r, file read /etc/app/** r, file read /var/data/profiles/** r, file write /var/log/app/access.log w, deny /var/log/app/** w, network inet stream, deny ptrace. The container runs as uid 1000 (non-root). Note: the CRLF injection in the Location header is technically present in the code path, but the AppArmor profile combined with the non-root execution context restricts the writeLog function to ONLY /var/log/app/access.log (not arbitrary paths). The configHandler path traversal via symlinks is blocked because the profile denies read access outside /etc/app/** and /var/data/profiles/**. The ACCESS_LOG_PATH environment variable is hardcoded in the container entrypoint to /var/log/app/access.log and the profile denies writes elsewhere.
